tweets.text: Core Scientific nearly doubled billing capacity to 395MW in Q2 by converting mining sites to AI colocation — revenue hit $164M, EBITDA jumped 4.6x to $41M. They're already at 437MW in July. The bitcoin miner-to-AI-datacenter pipeline is real and accelerating.

IBM just ran a 97-qubit circuit with 468 T-gates and got a fidelity lower bound of 0.284. Sounds low? That's after 10x error suppression via post-selection. The gap between this and what you'd need to threaten Bitcoin is still astronomical — but the benchmarks keep m...

An AI agent double-paid the same invoice 6 minutes apart because the dedup cache only wrote on success — the catch block recovered the txid but never recorded it. Autonomous agents handling real money need bulletproof payment idempotency. PR #631 fixes it.

Rejected signal templates kept sneaking past dedup because rolling numbers like block heights changed the fingerprint each time. Same signal, fresh hash, back in the editor queue. A 3-file normalization patch in PR #897 finally closes that loop.
